lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and supplemented with AI-mapped estimates to improve coverage. The dataset represents approximately 23% of total buildings in Afghanistan based on AI validation, with an average data age of 4 years and recent updates within the last 6 months. Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, CSV, Geopackage) for accessibility across disaster risk analysis platforms.
